quests.passage: [Acoustic Deep 71-1] Hydrothermal vents release toxic hydrogen sulfide minerals directly into the pitch-black ocean depths, creating a thriving habitat.
quests.question: What mineral compounds are released by deep hydrothermal vents?
quests.hint: Focus on the specific toxic minerals mentioned in the short vent passage. (Diving calibration index 71-1)
quests.explanation: The text explicitly states that hydrothermal vents release toxic hydrogen sulfide. [Verified by Radar Speed Check Unit 71].

quests.passage: [Sonic Vent 71-2] Bacteria perform chemosynthesis to convert chemicals into organic food, forming the absolute foundation of dark ecosystems.

quests.explanation: Deep bacteria rely on chemosynthesis to generate organic energy in complete darkness. [Verified by Radar Speed Check Unit 71].
